editorial.headline: Construction Equipment Rental, With the Operator Included
editorial.standfirst: A broad equipment-rental activity where the machinery comes with the operator—and remains open to foreign investment, including in Bali.
editorial.body:
This activity covers the rental of construction equipment, machinery and related gear **with an operator**. The operator is not incidental: it is part of the activity’s defining commercial shape. Its scope also extends to rented equipment used in the production and operation of oil, gas, petrochemical, geothermal and communications work, including supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) equipment, as well as cranes. It is therefore a practical operational category, built around supplying machinery together with the person who runs it.

The registration field is broad. The activity is open at Mikro, Kecil, Menengah and Besar scales, allowing the same core business model to sit within enterprises of very different sizes. That breadth matters because the record does not narrow the activity to a single construction niche or one type of client. Its focus is instead on the provision of equipment and machines, their associated accessories, and the operator required to put them to work.

Nationally, the position is straightforward: the activity is **TERBUKA** to foreign investment, with a foreign-ownership ceiling of **100%**. The cited basis is Perpres 10/2021 and 49/2021. In other words, the record presents no national foreign-equity cap below full ownership for this activity. For founders assessing the category at a national level, that is the central ownership fact: foreign participation can reach the stated 100% ceiling.

Bali does not reverse that position. The province’s permanent PMA moratorium blocks Low and Medium-Low risk activities island-wide, but this record is not marked as blocked for PMA registration in Bali. Its Bali status is recorded as OK or Higher Risk, and the stated reason is precise: at the Besar scale, the OSS risk is Medium-High/High, placing it outside the moratorium’s blocked risk bands. The honest reading is therefore not a hidden restriction, but a clear one: this activity remains available for PMA registration in Bali under the record’s stated higher-risk position.
editorial.pullQuote: In Bali, this activity is not marked as blocked for PMA registration because its Large-scale OSS risk sits above the moratorium’s blocked bands.
